actions.name: solve_pickup
actions.description: Grasp a selected compact object, close the gripper, and lift the object from its supporting surface.

actions.name: solve_put_into_bin
actions.description: Move the currently held object above a bin opening, release it into the bin.

actions.name: solve_button
actions.description: Move to a specified button, close the gripper and press it, then withdraw.

actions.name: grasp_and_lift_peg_side
actions.description: Approach a long peg from the side, grasp it securely, and lift it from the table.

actions.name: solve_push_to_target_with_peg
actions.description: While holding a peg, use the peg to push or hook a cube until the cube reaches its target.

actions.name: solve_push_to_target
actions.description: Use direct contact from an empty closed gripper to push a cube across the table to its target.

actions.name: solve_putonto_target
actions.description: Move the currently held object above a specified target, place it onto the target, and release it.

actions.name: solve_putdown
actions.description: Lower the currently held object onto an available table surface, release it, and move the gripper away.

actions.name: solve_button_ready
actions.description: Move above a specified button and hold a press-ready pose without actuating the button.

actions.name: solve_hold_abs_timestep
actions.description: Keep the robot static while the environment continues evolving, advancing only to the requested absolute-time checkpoint before observing again.

actions.name: solve_pickup_bin
actions.description: Grasp a selected white container from above, close the gripper, and lift the container from the table without treating any hidden cube as the grasp target.

actions.name: solve_swingonto_whenhold
actions.description: While continuing to hold an object, move it above a specified target disk without releasing it.

actions.name: insert_peg
actions.description: While holding the selected peg at the demonstrated end, align it with the box and insert it from the specified robot-left or robot-right side.

actions.name: solve_pattern_direction
actions.description: Move the end-effector-mounted stick continuously from its current grid target to the adjacent target in one specified robot-frame direction: forward, backward, left, right, or one of the four diagonals.

actions.name: solve_swingonto_with_direction
actions.description: Move the end-effector-mounted stick to the nearest specified-side target while circling the intervening obstacle clockwise or counterclockwise as requested.
